text:
Ava (Head of Product): quick follow-up from today's all-hands on pricing/usage. post short Qs about quotas, rate-limits, credits and we'll capture answers for a single FAQ.

Priya (Customer Success): customer asked if dev credits can be split across teams under one org. how granular are buckets?

Mike (Billing PM): you can create named buckets per-team for Dedicated/Private. hosted accounts get per-API-key quotas in Console. buckets are visible in billing UI and can be tied to different payment sources.

Tom (Solutions Eng): request: can we show an example of per-key quota YAML for Private? customers keep asking for the snippet.

Riley (SRE): sample we'll publish soon but simple example is allowed: `quotas:
  keys:
    key-frontend: monthly_tokens: 1000000
    key-batch: monthly_units: 200000` — we'll formalize and add to runbook.

Priya (Customer Success): what precisely happens when credits run out mid-day? client wants to know if long requests are killed.

Riley (SRE): behavior: if a request was accepted before the hard cap, it will complete. new requests will be soft-degraded first (non-critical routes throttled). hard cap blocks new accepts. we'll add clear examples in the FAQ.

Mike (Billing PM): note: soft-degrade is configurable per-account. some enterprise customers prefer immediate hard caps. default is soft-degrade with notifications.

Priya (Customer Success): refund question: if an automated burst was applied incorrectly and consumed credits, what is the remediation path?

Mike (Billing PM): standard path: open billing ticket with logs, we triage, provisional credit within 7 business days for verified platform errors, user errors handled with one-time goodwill credits at manager discretion.

Tom (Solutions Eng): propagation question: how long until a top-up appears globally? had a customer see delay across regions.

Riley (SRE): typical propagation is <90s for hosted; <2m for some Private deploys depending on control-plane connectivity. we recommend scheduling top-ups a minute before heavy traffic.

Ava (Head of Product): can we add a short line about 429s and billing? customers ask if retries bill.

Riley (SRE): 429 responses do not consume token/embedding credits. only accepted requests that proceed to generation are billed. retries that succeed will consume as normal.

Priya (Customer Success): rollover: do unused hosted credits carry over?

Mike (Billing PM): hosted promotional/dev credits expire. committed/reserved credits may roll over per contract. we'll add a short chart in the FAQ to make this explicit.

Tom (Solutions Eng): small ask: a one-click console flow to request temporary burst for launches would reduce tickets. is that in roadmap?

Mike (Billing PM): yes, self-serve temporary burst is live for hosted (requires payment method). Dedicated/Private requires CS coordination. we'll include steps in the FAQ.

Ava (Head of Product): action items: Mike to draft FAQ snippet on refunds/rollover/burst, Riley to add 429/propagation notes to rate-limit doc, Tom to collect a customer YAML example. we'll publish consolidated doc.

alerts-bot: pinned: /docs/usage/quotas-and-credits.md

Ava (Head of Product): thanks everyone. leaving this open 24h for any last Qs then moving to docs. :white_check_mark:
